resources.string: SkipFlow reads visible controls in YouTube and YouTube Music and taps an available Skip ad button on your behalf. It does not skip unskippable ads. When enabled, Lower ad volume reduces media volume to 1 during detected ads and restores the previous volume afterward. Screen contents are processed on your device and are not saved or sent anywhere. Floating controls offer Pause, Resume, and Home. A brief animation shows the updated count after skip clicks. Both features can be turned off in SkipFlow. You can disable this service at any time.
